say:1:1230246001:1.text: A hornrhino! They mostly inhabit the plains and have an aggressive temperament!
say:1:1230246001:1.source_cn: 烈角犀，它们多生活在平原，性情暴躁！
say:1:1230246001:1.male: A hornrhino! They mostly inhabit the plains and have an aggressive temperament!
say:1:1230246001:1.female: A hornrhino! They mostly inhabit the plains and have an aggressive temperament!

say:2:1230246002:1.text: If there are unfamiliar animals or anything disturbing in its surroundings, it will lower its head and show its rock-hard horns intimidatingly.
say:2:1230246002:1.source_cn: 要是周围有陌生的动物，或是让它不安的因素，它就会低下头...
say:2:1230246002:1.male: If there are unfamiliar animals or anything disturbing in its surroundings, it will lower its head and show its rock-hard horns intimidatingly.
say:2:1230246002:1.female: If there are unfamiliar animals or anything disturbing in its surroundings, it will lower its head and show its rock-hard horns intimidatingly.

say:3:1230246003:1.text: What a surprise to find a single hornrhino living in the forest beyond Rustport! This is interesting; I must study it properly...
say:3:1230246003:1.source_cn: 没想到竟然有个体生活在锈锚港外的雨林，这可真是新鲜，我...
say:3:1230246003:1.male: What a surprise to find a single hornrhino living in the forest beyond Rustport! This is interesting; I must study it properly...
say:3:1230246003:1.female: What a surprise to find a single hornrhino living in the forest beyond Rustport! This is interesting; I must study it properly...

say:4:1230246004:1.text: Oh, make sure you don't provoke it! If it rams into you head-on, you could be in serious danger!
say:4:1230246004:1.source_cn: 哦，你也是，一定要注意别惹怒它！如果正面遭受烈角犀的冲...

say:4:1230246004:1.female: Oh, make sure you don't provoke it! If it rams into you head-on, you could be in serious danger!
